name: Eyes Sewn Shut
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 1, bloodrager 1, cleric/oracle 2, lathspell 1, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one corporeal creature
Duration permanent; see text
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and the target’s eyes are fused shut. On a failed saving throw the target is blinded.

This blinding is permanent unless the target forces their eyes open with a DC 10 Strength check, a full-round DC 15 Heal check is performed on the target, or the target cuts their eyes open. The Strength check or cutting option deals 1d6 damage and 1 bleed damage.

Using the Heal check option still deals 1d6 damage but negates the bleed.

This spell is not affected by remove blindness but can be removed by heal, dispel magic, limited wish, wish, or miracle. This spell cannot target creatures without eyes or flesh with which to cover their eyes.
